description.value:
Test plan for the **Medication Overview Responder** actor (the *MEOW server*) defined by the [IHE PHARM Medication Overview (MEOW)](https://profiles.ihe.net/PHARM/MEOW/index.html) implementation guide.
The suites below are split one per transaction - PHARM-11 Query Medication Resources and PHARM-12 Retrieve Medication Overview Document - matching the one-transaction-per-scenario structure of the Gherkin script. Each `suite.test` corresponds to one `Scenario:` in that script, matched by its `tc-meow-server-NNN` identifier.
The system under test is the **server**: the test bed originates every request and asserts on the response it gets back.

purpose.value: To declare, in a machine-readable and runnable form, which behaviours a system claiming conformance to the MEOW Medication Overview Responder actor must demonstrate.

description.value: The Medication Overview Responder (MEOW server) actor - the system under test.
Tests every Medication Overview Responder must pass.
Tests that only apply to a Responder claiming the Document Option (PHARM-12).
Search on MedicationStatement, profiled as MedicationTreatmentLine. The patient parameter is required; status, effective, category and _lastUpdated are optional.
The required baseline: a patient-scoped search returns that patient's treatment lines.

human.value: The response is 200 and a Bundle of type searchset with at least one entry.
Every entry is a MedicationStatement whose subject resolves to the requested patient.
Every entry declares the MedicationTreatmentLine profile in meta.profile.

name.value: tc-meow-server-002 PHARM-11 honours the optional search parameters

description.value: status, category and _lastUpdated actually filter server-side rather than being ignored.

human.value: A search filtered by status=active returns 200 and every entry carries that status.
A search filtered by category returns 200 and a searchset.
A search with _lastUpdated set in the future returns 200 and an empty searchset - proof the parameter is applied rather than ignored.

name.value: tc-meow-server-003 PHARM-11 rejects a query without the required patient

description.value: Negative test: an unscoped MedicationStatement search must be refused, not answered.

human.value: The body is an OperationOutcome carrying at least one issue of severity error or fatal.

description.value: Document Option. Search for and read a Medication Overview document Bundle, then validate it against the MedicationOverview profile.

name.value: tc-meow-server-004 PHARM-12 returns a conformant MedicationOverview

description.value: A document search returns document Bundles, and a document read returns one that validates against the profile.

human.value: A search with patient and type=document returns 200 and a searchset whose entries are all Bundles of type document.
Reading a Medication Overview document returns 200 and a Bundle of type document.
The retrieved document validates against the MEOW MedicationOverview profile.
The document holds exactly one Composition, plus a Patient and at least one MedicationStatement.
